structured.rankingRationale: HIV Science ranks first because official managed housing and group booking are explicit. ERNOP and RELAIS follow for actionable organizer/hotel-information windows and local public-sector access. Palexpo events are valuable but venue-committed; Lausanne/Les Diablerets rank lower for hotel fit.
